Hi Sarah — great to connect, thanks for sending the signed SOW. Quick proposal below (happy to adjust based on GlobeFin ops constraints):

Proposed drawdown approach (recommended for predictable unit economics):
- Initial tranche: $75k upfront (clears immediate onboarding & reserved capacity). Due within 30 days of invoice.
- Monthly sweeps: 11 monthly drawdowns of $20,000 each, invoiced at the start of each month with a 30-day due date. Sweeps triggered at the 1st of each month; we can align the invoice date to your PO number.
- Burn-based top-up: if monthly usage exceeds 110% of expected, an automated mid-month invoice can be issued for the overage.

VAT and evidence: we can provide line-item invoices showing net/gross, VAT amount, and the following evidence fields in a CSV/XLSX: Redwood VAT registration number (per country), invoice number, invoice date, recipient VAT ID, service description, and taxing jurisdiction. I attached a small template (VAT_Evidence_FR.xlsx) that our billing team can populate and that your tax team can validate.

Invoice/PO guidance:
- Please include your GlobeFin PO on the invoice as PO-XXXX. We will include the PO on all invoice PDFs and metadata.
- Invoices will be issued from Redwood Inference B.V. (EU entity) where applicable; let us know if remittance should go to a specific Redwood legal entity.

Next steps:
1) Marissa (cc) will confirm invoice remit details and provide wire instructions for the initial tranche.
2) Sarah — if you can populate the VAT_Evidence_FR template with GlobeFin VAT IDs and return, we’ll attach the confirmed evidence to each monthly invoice.

Attaching: VAT_Evidence_FR.xlsx (template)
